title: Stress Management: WHO's 5 Skills, Daily Habits and When to See a Doctor
seoTitle: Stress Management: 5 WHO Skills and Habits That Work
seoDescription: Manage stress with WHO's five free skills, NHS-backed habits like slow breathing and routine, and know when to see a doctor or call Tele-MANAS 14416.
excerpt: Grounding, unhooking and three more WHO skills explained step by step, how stress differs from burnout and anxiety, exam and work-hour pressures in India, and the signs that mean you should get help.
